messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App worked yesterday after deployment but today url returns 404
parts:
Andy,

My app (https://lincrampton.shinyapps.io/time2retire/) is exhibiting the same 404 behaviour, after having worked nicely for a while.  I re-deployed the app, tried to run it under a different name, I ran shinyApps::terminateApp and then tried everything again.  Nothing works. 

Could i have exceeded my resource allocation?  On the Accounts page, it says, "Resources are allocated to accounts. The accounts of which you're a member determine how many applications you can provision and what resources they can consume. In the coming weeks, we will be adding more functionality to this page"  I am at a loss to figure out why an app that ran so nicely for a while absolutely refuses to do anything.

lin

Lin,

When I look at your application code that was uploaded, I see the following directory structure:

39d8882ce51a4c36a3dff5328eb16996
├── index.htm
├── manifest.json
├── shinyRules.R
└── time2retire

Preparing to deploy application...
